Situation: Exploring an abandoned tower where a mad alchemist conducted experiments, entering a plague-infested crypt, or investigating a dark ritual site.
Description: Adam Skorupa's dark atmospheric tracking piece filled with low-frequency industrial drones, unexpected metallic echoes, and tense, weeping strings. Evokes a thick layer of physical danger, ancient decay, and a landscape soaked in blood.

Name: Witcher 1 - Do You Remember
Situation: A quiet roleplay conversation about a character's tragic backstory, looking over a ruined hometown, or a bittersweet farewell to a companion.
Description: A deeply melancholic, bittersweet melody driven by slow, weeping traditional acoustic strings and soft woodwind notes. Evokes a profound sense of heavy memory, personal loss, and the quiet burdens of a wanderer's life.

Name: Witcher 1 - Kaer Morhen
Situation: Arriving at a highly secure, ancient mountain fortress stronghold belonging to friendly NPCs, or looking out at a stunning valley sunrise.
Description: A beautiful, sweeping acoustic fantasy theme blending a soaring solo violin with warm acoustic guitars and a grand, open-air atmospheric scale. Evokes nostalgic wonder, historic pride, and a rare, safe sanctuary from a cruel world.

Name: Witcher 1 - Peaceful Moments (Adam Skorupa)
Situation: Setting up a campfire in a genuinely safe clearing, collecting herbs in an enchanted forest grove, or a relaxed travel montage on a sunny day.
Description: A gentle, rolling ambient track utilizing soft acoustic guitar picking, light woodwinds, and a tranquil natural atmosphere. Evokes complete decompression, rustic safety, and unhurried wilderness exploration.

Name: Witcher 2 - A Watering Hole in the Harbor
Situation: The party visiting a lively, rough-around-the-edges docks tavern, gambling on arm wrestling games, or trying to pick up rumors from rowdy sailors.
Description: A raucous, highly energetic tavern track driven by fast acoustic lutes, bouncing percussion, and lively folk instruments. Evokes a gritty, bustling port atmosphere where working-class sailors drink, fight, and revel.

Name: Witcher 2 - An Army Lying in Wait
Situation: The party coordinating a tactical ambush on a mountain road, or standing on a wall listening to the distant drums of an oncoming army.
Description: A high-tension tactical loop featuring a deep military snare drum cadence, low-intensity war horns, and continuous, anxious string trills. Evokes a severe siege countdown, calculated ambush planning, and hidden military forces.

Name: Witcher 2 - Dwarven Stone
Situation: Entering a thriving, subterranean dwarven metropolis, drinking inside an underground mountain brewery, or visiting an artisan forge guild.
Description: A heavy, proud folk track built on rhythmic acoustic strumming, deep, rolling male hums, and a grounded percussive beat. Evokes immense physical stonework, traditional dwarf camaraderie, and a busy, bustling underground hub.

Name: Witcher 2 - Howl of the White Wolf
Situation: A dangerous combat encounter against a fast, predatory monster like a werewolf, or engaging in a chaotic sword duel with a skilled rival assassin.
Description: An aggressive, fast-paced orchestral combat theme featuring frantic traditional Slavic string work, booming percussion hits, and fierce vocal accents. Evokes peak adrenaline, lethal swordplay, and professional monster hunting.

Name: Witcher 2 - Vergen by Night
Situation: Walking through an underground or cliffside town after dark when the shops have closed, or taking a quiet night watch inside a hollow mountain.
Description: A beautiful, mysterious, and deeply atmospheric night theme driven by a slow acoustic guitar motif, exotic woodwinds, and a vast, echoing cave-like background layer. Evokes subterranean mystery, dark stone paths, and a peaceful night's rest.

Name: Witcher 3 - Aen Seidhe (Mikolai Stroinski)
Situation: Exploring long-abandoned elven ruins overgrown with moss, speaking with an ancient archdruid, or listening to a tragic piece of history regarding a dying race.
Description: Mikolai Stroinski's beautiful, sweepingly nostalgic and melancholic elven piece featuring a solo woodwind melody and soft, weeping traditional strings. Evokes ancient, forgotten elven history, cultural sorrow, and natural isolation.

Name: Witcher 3 - Forged in Fire
Situation: Fighting fire elementals in a ruined volcanic forge, or a chaotic, high-speed brawl against a bandit camp that has caught fire.
Description: An aggressive, fast-paced folk-combat arrangement featuring frantic string work, booming traditional frame drums, and high-energy pacing. Evokes a rapid, chaotic sword skirmish, fiery environments, and professional combat survival.

Name: Witcher 3 - Igni
Situation: Kicking off a sudden encounter where a player triggers a massive fiery explosion trap, or executing a devastating surprise spell attack.
Description: A sharp, explosive percussive hit followed by a continuous, intense tracking string loop that spikes in volume with crackling, high-tension accents. Evokes immediate danger, localized heat, and rapid tactical spellcasting.

Name: Witcher 3 - Ladies of the Woods (Alina Gingertail)
Situation: Navigating a dark, mist-heavy swamp towards an altar, interacting with a powerful coven of crones, or tracking a dark entity through twisted bogs.
Description: Alina Gingertail's multi-instrumental traditional cover utilizing the hurdy-gurdy, lutes, and multi-layered chanting vocals to construct a driving, deeply unsettling folk groove. Evokes ancient bog magic, primal woodland cults, and manipulative crones.

Name: Witcher 3 - Ladies of the Woods (Laszlo Horvath)
Situation: Confronting a powerful night hag in her lair, discovering human-sacrifice shrines deep in a marsh, or a tense, terrifying parley with ancient bog spirits.
Description: A darker, raw performance emphasizing heavy hurdy-gurdy sawing, deep, repetitive thumping percussion, and an incredibly oppressive, ritualistic cadence. Evokes absolute visceral dread, severe witchcraft, and inescapable swamp horrors.

Name: Witcher 3 - No Surrender
Situation: Defending a broken castle courtyard from endless waves of monsters, or holding a bottleneck bridge against an encroaching warlord's vanguard.
Description: A massive, bombastic combat anthem pairing roaring traditional strings with chaotic battlefield percussion and furious vocal battle shouts. Evokes absolute desperate resolve, bloody military attrition, and fighting to the very last man.

Name: Witcher 3 - Steel for Humans (Laszlo Horvath)
Situation: A chaotic alleyway brawl against city thugs, fighting a corrupt garrison of guards in a market square, or a high-stakes duel against a rival swordsman.
Description: A highly energetic, iconic battle track utilizing frantic, clashing acoustic instruments, rapid string bowing, and the famous Bulgarian vocal chanting rhythm. Evokes extreme swordplay adrenaline, chaotic street fights, and lethal steel blades clashing.

Name: Witcher 3 - Песня Присциллы (Elena Minina)
Situation: A renowned bard performing a deeply emotional historical ballad at a packed noble inn, silencing the entire room with a tragic love story.
Description: Elena Minina's breathtaking, crystal-clear Russian vocal cover of 'The Wolven Storm,' backed by delicate, shimmering acoustic lute plucking. Evokes profound romantic longing, bittersweet memories, and pure narrative enchantment.

Name: Witcher Blood and Wine - Cannot Let You Leave
Situation: A high-stakes boss battle against an ancient vampire lord, an elite dark knight, or cornering a lethal royal assassin inside an estate.
Description: An incredibly fast, aggressive, and theatrical gothic-orchestral battle track featuring screaming violins, thunderous drums, and panicked operatic chorus swells. Evokes a frantic struggle for survival against a highly lethal, aristocratic predator.

Name: Witcher Hearts of Stone - Gaunter o' Dimm (Alina Gingertail)
Situation: An encounter or tense parley with a deceptively polite archdevil, a powerful trickster entity, or a malevolent cosmic dealer who has come to collect a soul.
Description: Alina Gingertail's multi-layered acoustic cover of the Master Mirror motif, blending a sweet but deeply unsettling children's nursery rhyme melody with slow, buzzing folk instruments. Evokes profound psychological terror, malicious deals, and Faustian dread hidden behind a polite facade.

Name: Witcher Hearts of Stone - Hearts of Stone Main Theme (Marcin Przybyłowicz)
Situation: Introductions to a new, dark story arc involving an ancient family curse, or exploring a noble estate whose inhabitants suffered a horrific, tragic fate.
Description: Marcin Przybyłowicz's grand but deeply tragic, sweeping string arrangement that blends traditional Slavic mournfulness with a sense of decaying grandeur and a cold, inescapable curse. Evokes an overarching atmosphere of historical tragedy, lost humanity, and grim choices.

Name: Witcher Hearts of Stone - Mystery Man (Marcin Przybylowicz)
Situation: Investigating a scene where time itself has frozen, searching for a hidden contract in a wizard's study, or realizing the party is being toyed with by a god.
Description: A slow, nerve-wracking atmospheric tracking piece that relies heavily on a repeating, delicate high-pitched chime sequence that mimics a ticking pocket watch, layered over an uncomfortably deep string pad. Evokes a sense of running out of time, cosmic surveillance, and absolute focus.

Name: Witcher Hearts of Stone - The House Of The Borsodis
Situation: Executing a high-stakes auction house robbery, sneaking past guard posts into a bank vault, or charting out a complex heist itinerary with an NPC group.
Description: A smooth, highly calculating, and rhythmic acoustic piece driven by structured cello plucks, low-intensity hand percussion, and a steady pacing that signals professional infiltration. Evokes a meticulous heist operation, casing a target, and urban espionage.

Name: Witcher Hearts of Stone - Whatsoever A Man Soweth
Situation: The ultimate final confrontation against an archdevil inside their own twisting pocket dimension, or a desperate race against a ticking clock to solve a world-ending riddle.
Description: The ultimate, apocalyptic climax theme for the Master Mirror arc. Booming, thunderous war drums clash with distorted traditional instruments and a screaming, frantic choir that echoes a distorted version of the nursery rhyme melody. Evokes absolute cosmic doom, reality-warping panic, and the final hour.
